fields.name: method
fields.description: The way the demonstration moved the cube, fixed at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and never changed afterwards. Write `pick` when the demonstration shows the cube marked as held in the gripper while the gripper rises well above the table (height above about 0.08) with fingers partly closed around it (about 40-60% open), and the cube is then released over the target. Write `hook` when the demonstration shows the stick (peg) marked as held in the gripper, with fingers closed to about 20-25%, and the stick dragged against the cube toward the target. Write `push` when the demonstration shows the fingers closing to about 0% (closing on nothing) at table height (below about 0.04) and the cube then sliding to the target while the gripper never rises with it; neither cube nor stick is ever held while raised. Same value at every step of the episode. e.g. hook

fields.name: holding
fields.description: What the robot has in its fingers at this decision step, judged from the execution steps shown. `none` at the first decision step and whenever the fingers are fully open or closed on nothing. Judge a grasp from the gripper trace alone, never from object coordinates or held marks: execution steps carry no 'is held in the gripper' mark, and an object's listed position can stay frozen at its old place after it has been lifted, so an unchanged listed position and the absence of a held mark are not evidence against a grasp. `peg` once the execution steps show the gripper at table height (below about 0.05) within about 20 px of the stick's listed position, the fingers going from 100% open to about 20-30%, and the gripper then rising (height above about 0.10) with the fingers still at about 20-30%. `cube` the same way but within about 20 px of the cube's listed position and with the fingers settling at about 40-60%. Equivalent shortcut: if the scene at the decision step shows the gripper raised above about 0.10 with fingers at about 20-30%, the value is `peg`; raised with fingers at about 40-60%, `cube`. Back to `none` once a later step shows the fingers reopen to 100%. e.g. peg
